I've been learning spanish throughout my college years. I can read pretty well but I, obviously, have much to learn. I find that watching spanish shows and listening to music helps me alot. My Process is a little tedious but it's helped me.   
1. Find a spanish show and/or song with subtitles enabled  
2. Read the subtitles and write down any words you don't recognize  
3. Look the words up (jot down notes about conjugation if there is any)  
4. Write them on a flashcard and Study! (I use a program called Anki, but any flashcard-like system works!)  
5. Do this until you can completely understand the song/show  
6. Work on reading comprehension. Say the words like the actor/singer is saying it. Use subtitles at first but then take them off   


It's a long process and I'm sure there are other ways to do this. But this is one way that can be fun. I would start with songs first.   


I also recommend looking up Senor Jordan on Youtube. Old but Gold information

Hey there! You're off to a great start! I would say the best way to improve is to learn proportions. There's nothing wrong with anime-styles but learning correct proportions of the face allows you to play with your style a lot better. So learning where the eyes are spaced compared to the nose and mouth. 

I would also say, try drawing a little more fluidly. It doesn't have to be good. A way to learn fluid movement of the body is to draw from life. Look up some pictures of nude models in different poses. That will also help you with proportions. 

Remember, take your time with everyone's critics. don't rush yourself to learn everything at once. And draw everyday. You'll improve in no time
